name: Missouri Prairie Foundation Prairie Garden Grants
summary: Small grants for conservation groups, parks, schools and other entities to establish or improve public gardens and plantings of native prairie plants in Missouri and neighbouring states.
reporting: A brief update with photos six months after the award, and a full report with photos by May of the following year.

applicant_types.quote: Gardening and other conservation groups, parks, schools, and other entities in Missouri and immediately surrounding states are invited to submit proposals

access.quote: A link to the application is here.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching funds are not required, but proposals with secured matching funds may be evaluated higher than others.

reporting.quote: A brief update with photos is requested 6 months after the grant is awarded, and a full report with photos is required by May of the following year.
